facts.text: I want to organize my photos from recent trips.
I have a lot of photos from a beach vacation.
I took over 200 photos of scenery and wildlife during a recent outing.
I experimented with different modes and settings on my Canon EOS 80D.
I am comfortable with Adobe Lightroom's ecosystem.
I want to efficiently import and organize my photos in Lightroom.
I want to create a separate collection for each type of photo in Lightroom.
I want separate collections for landscapes, wildlife, and flora.
I want to create a smart collection for all the photos I took during my beach vacation.
I want the smart collection to include photos I took during sunrise and sunset.
I want to access the Develop module in Lightroom to edit photos.
I want to make basic adjustments to a photo in Lightroom.
I want to adjust the exposure and contrast of a photo to make it look more vibrant.
I want to recover details in the shadows of a photo.

keyphrases: smart collection date range and location

events.text: Beach vacation photo organization with sunrise and sunset photos included in a smart collection
